main.description: List commit history reachable from a ref, newest first. The ref may be any full ref name, including refs/cobs/*.

ref.description: Git revision (branch, tag, commit Object ID, or full ref name)

path.description: Only list commits touching this path

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return in this page

cursor.description: Commit Object ID of the last commit in the previous page
Cursor for the next page, absent when the last page is reached

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: Repo is not registered on this knot

errors.name: RefNotFound
errors.description: The given ref doesn't resolve in this repo

errors.name: PathNotFound
errors.description: The given path doesn't exist at the given ref
